reason: V2-05 audit repair. Trusted shell committed repair baseline (b22e7d3) with ShareCard component, ScoreScreen share button, theme contrast adjustments, V2-05 acceptance tests, and all audit reports. 361 tests green, typecheck clean, Android build OK. Five mustFix findings remain: (1) Share sheet uses Web Share API (navigator.share) instead of native Share API — does not open on Android APK; (2) ShareCard is dead code, never rendered in any screen; (3) Visual evidence gallery required by QG-4/DESIGN_BRIEF is absent; (4) textSecondary/textMuted fail WCAG AA contrast on all surfaces; (5) Options screen shows 'Notifications push: Activées' while LocalNotificationAdapter.isAvailable()=false. Criterion V2-05 stays active. WIP repair baseline preserved. Next cycle must fix all 5 mustFix findings.

nextTask.objective: V2-05 repair — fix all 5 mustFix findings from audit 33357496099. The WIP repair baseline is already committed (ShareCard, ScoreScreen share, theme adjustments). The next Builder must: (1) replace Web Share API with native Share API (react-native Share or expo-sharing) in LocalSystemShareAdapter; (2) integrate ShareCard into the share flow so visual cards are actually rendered and shared as images; (3) produce the visual evidence gallery required by QG-4; (4) darken textSecondary/textMuted to achieve ≥4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast on all surfaces; (5) fix Options notification display to show honest states reflecting adapter availability.
nextTask.scope: Repair findings mustFix #1-#5 from audit RUN_33357496099. Do not add new features. Do not weaken existing acceptance criteria. Preserve all V2-00..V2-04 evidence. All 361+ tests must remain green. Navigation stays exactly 3 tabs.

mustFixFindings.problem: Share sheet relies on navigator.share (Web Share API) which does not exist on Android APK. isAvailable() always returns false on native. The share sheet never opens.
mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Implement adapter using Share.share from react-native (or expo-sharing) for native platforms. Keep isAvailable() honest. Add test verifying delegation to native API.
mustFixFindings.verification: On Android APK, sharing from Score and history opens native share sheet.

mustFixFindings.problem: ShareCard component is never rendered in any screen. Only generateShareText is used — sharing produces text only, not visual cards.
mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Integrate ShareCard into the share flow: render it and share as image via SystemShareGateway (files option), or document why visual sharing is deferred.
mustFixFindings.verification: Share from Score/history produces a visual card (image) via native share sheet.

mustFixFindings.problem: Required visual evidence gallery per QG-4/DESIGN_BRIEF is completely absent. No screenshots exist in the repository.
mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Produce the gallery: login, root households, Add Premium, Add Free + archive, Score Premium, Score Free, To-do Premium, completion mini-form, To-do Free, upsell history, Options, share card, empty states/errors — as reproducible audit artifacts.
mustFixFindings.verification: Gallery artifacts exist and are reproducible from the accepted tree.

mustFixFindings.problem: textSecondary #81B29A and textMuted #A8A8B3 fail WCAG AA (4.5:1) on all surfaces (2.03-2.40:1). Warning/surface=2.97. Primary/background=4.47.
mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Darken textSecondary, textMuted, warning, and primary to achieve ≥4.5:1 on all surfaces. Extend contrast tests to all text/surface pairs actually used.
mustFixFindings.verification: Automated contrast check passes WCAG AA for all used pairs.

mustFixFindings.problem: Options shows 'Notifications push: Activées', 'Rappels de tâches: Activés', 'Nouvelles assignations: Activées' while LocalNotificationAdapter.isAvailable()=false.
mustFixFindings.requiredFix: Display honest states ('Non configuré' / 'Indisponible') or wire to real adapter availability.
mustFixFindings.verification: Options notification states match actual adapter availability.

nonBlockingFindings.problem: Tautological assertions: expect(true).toBe(true) at lines 700/828, typeof boolean checks, hardcoded strings.
Touch targets too small (share button ~16px, tabs ~40px), no accessibilityRole/accessibilityLabel.
nonBlockingFindings.requiredFix: Targets ≥44px, add roles/labels on interactive elements.

nonBlockingFindings.problem: Dead option rows (QG-1): 'Changer le mot de passe', 'Gérer l'abonnement', etc. — clickable without onPress or disabled state.
Upsell To-do Free shown proactively on tab open instead of on creation attempt.
nonBlockingFindings.requiredFix: Tab usable in Free, upsell triggered on attempt.
